ns2:section.sectionText: Swords and Roses: The Romance in Cross-Cultural Perspective Course description: This course approaches the world of knights and fair maidens from a cross-cultural perspective. Through literature and film, we will examine classic Greek, Persian and Chinese tales, medieval Arthurian romances, and modern parodies of the genre. We will examine the illusions and disillusions of romance, including themes like star-crossed lovers, chivalry, social identity and war.
